name: BÀN CỜ — Video Design System
style: Financial Journalism × Swiss Editorial × Corporate Annual Report
colorRules: Use white or warm white (#FAFAF7) as the dominant graphic surface.
Use forest-green (#376B50) for the primary chart series or highlighted business mechanism.
Use brass (#B18D55) for benchmark or secondary emphasis only; avoid shiny gold effects.
Do not use red and green as the only indicators of good and bad; pair with explicit values and arrows.
Avoid neon trading colors, electric gradients, and black-and-gold luxury finance ads.
